2607.22841.title: Language-Routed RAG and Direct Option Scoring for Multilingual Financial QA: DS@GT at FinMMEval
2607.22841.paper_summary: We present DS@GT's submission to FinMMEval 2026 Task 1, a multilingual financial exam question answering benchmark spanning English, Spanish, Greek, Chinese, and Hindi. Financial certification exams such as the CFA, EFPA, and CPA demand structured domain reasoning that standard NLP benchmarks do not capture, and this challenge compounds across languages where retrieval and representation infrastructure is underdeveloped. We build a retrieval-augmented pipeline on LangGraph that detects query language and retrieves semantically relevant exemplars from a 30,209-entry multilingual knowledge base using BGE-M3 embeddings and FAISS indexing. The system then scores answers via Retrieval-Augmented Direct Scoring (RADS), reading next-token log-probabilities over candidate option letters rather than generating free-form output. For low-resource languages, we fuse per-language and cross-lingual retrieval indices using weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Model selection is language-routed: Qwen3-14B for Arabic, Chinese, and Hindi; Qwen2.5-14B for English; and Llama-3.1-8B for Greek, a routing derived from empirical ablations that reveal substantial language-asymmetric performance gaps. Notably, chain-of-thought prompting significantly degrades Greek accuracy (90.7% to 20.9%), and enabling Qwen3's default thinking mode collapses Arabic RADS performance to near-chance levels. Our results indicate that effective multilingual financial reasoning requires language-aware retrieval, model routing, and deliberate scoring strategy selection.
2607.22841.paper_summary_zh: 我們呈現 DS@GT 對 FinMMEval 2026 任務 1 的提交，這是一個涵蓋英語、西班牙語、希臘語、中文和印地語的多語言金融考試問題回答基準。金融認證考試如 CFA、EFPA 和 CPA 需要結構化的領域推理，而標準的 NLP 基準無法捕捉到這一點，這一挑戰在檢索和表示基礎設施尚不發達的語言中更加複雜。我們在 LangGraph 上構建了一個增強檢索的管道，該管道檢測查詢語言並使用 BGE-M3 嵌入和 FAISS 索引從一個包含 30,209 條目的多語言知識庫中檢索語義相關的範例。系統然後通過增強檢索直接打分（RADS）來評分答案，閱讀候選選項字母的下一個標記的對數概率，而不是生成自由格式的輸出。對於資源匱乏的語言，我們使用加權的互惠排名融合來融合每種語言和跨語言的檢索索引。模型選擇是基於語言路由的：對於阿拉伯語、中文和印地語使用 Qwen3-14B；對於英語使用 Qwen2.5-14B；對於希臘語使用 Llama-3.1-8B，這一路由源自經驗性消融實驗，揭示了顯著的語言不對稱性能差距。值得注意的是，思維鏈提示顯著降低了希臘語的準確性（從 90.7% 降至 20.9%），而啟用 Qwen3 的默認思考模式則將阿拉伯語的 RADS 性能壓縮到接近隨機水平。我們的結果表明，有效的多語言金融推理需要語言感知的檢索、模型路由和深思熟慮的打分策略選擇。
2607.22841.author: Justice Ayela et.al.
